reference_opening.argument: This video is scam content because it actively promotes recruiting people into a OneCoin affiliate network through a sponsor invite link, lead-capture funnel, follow-up messaging, and placement of new members. It presents recruitment-linked dashboard metrics such as bonus earnings and sponsored members while instructing the viewer how to sign up additional participants, making the central activity a network-based earning solicitation rather than a neutral account tutorial.

citations.quote: What do I share with people to join me in onecoin.
We offer everybody a free lead capture page system that has certainly proven to work.
you can capture the information and that way you'll be able to follow-up as well as having a email series drip on that person over a number of days
your invite link is right here And so you can simply copy this and give that to anybody that you would like
make sure is that you have the placement of new members set to the side where they should be going

opening.argument: The speaker uses measured, conditional language rather than promising an outcome. The viewer is told to “consider” a lead-capture system, and the operational guidance is framed as a recommendation for affiliates who already use the platform. The explanation identifies where the invite link is and how placement works, but it does not state that recruiting will produce a guaranteed return or that participation is risk-free. That makes this a cautious account-orientation video, not a deceptive assurance of financial success.

citations.quote: you certainly want to consider using the lead capture page system
Its always recommended that you use a lead capture page
if you're on the one coins partners team

rebuttal.rebuttal: The cited recruiting language identifies platform functionality, but it does not establish that the video guarantees earnings or conceals risk. “Follow-up” and an email series describe communication workflow, while “placement” describes where an account is arranged. Those phrases can support an ordinary instructional reading without proving that the creator made a deceptive financial promise.

citations.quote: you can capture the information and that way you'll be able to follow-up
you have the placement of new members set to the side where they should be going

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The careful wording does not neutralize the conduct being taught. The speaker explicitly asks what to share so others can join, provides an invite link, and recommends a lead-capture process for follow-up. The absence of an express guarantee is not evidence that the recruitment solicitation is merely harmless account support.

citations.quote: What do I share with people to join me in onecoin.
your invite link is right here And so you can simply copy this and give that to anybody that you would like
you can capture the information and that way you'll be able to follow-up

opening.argument: The video's observable purpose is operational instruction: it answers where a user can find a link, demonstrates navigation through a profile, and explains an optional placement setting. The speaker even directs viewers to other videos or sponsor support when they do not understand the strategy. That is characteristic of a software and account-use tutorial. Showing how a platform's controls operate is not, by itself, a claim that the platform is safe or that every viewer should join.

citations.quote: you can simply come into your account Click here on your profile go to the main information
And so you can simply copy this and give that to anybody that you would like
if you don't understand this strategy you need to watch the other videos on this youtube channel or maybe even get with your sponsor or other upline support

rebuttal.rebuttal: Calling the video a tutorial does not answer what the tutorial teaches. Its navigation instructions culminate in copying an invite link, signing up a new member, and choosing that member's placement. Those are not merely neutral password or profile settings; they are instructions for adding participants through the account.

citations.quote: your invite link is right here
you can also click right here on this blue button to sign up a new member
make sure is that you have the placement of new members set to the side where they should be going

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The interface demonstration is the means of the solicitation, not an answer to it. The speaker does not simply explain where a setting is; the stated objective is getting people to sign up directly with the speaker. The tutorial framing therefore describes how the recruitment is carried out, while the invite and placement instructions show its purpose.

citations.quote: for the purpose of this video where is your onecoin link to share to get people to sign up directly
with you it's right here under the profile and main information

opening.argument: The supplied material shows account administration and a referral-style service interface, not the core mechanics of a financial scam. The profile page presents an invite-link control, member-placement choices, and auto-buy options; the narration explains how to use those controls. It does not show the speaker requesting credentials, instructing a viewer to send money, promising a return, or describing guaranteed downline income. Recruitment and a referral link can occur in ordinary platform commerce, so the missing financial mechanism matters.

citations.quote: you can simply come into your account Click here on your profile go to the main information
you can simply copy this and give that to anybody that you would like
what you just want to make sure is that you have the placement of new members set to the side where they should be going

rebuttal.rebuttal: The missing items do not erase the mechanism that is present. The video promotes a link for enrolling others, a lead-capture funnel, follow-up messaging, and placement in a network. A financial solicitation need not request credentials or state a guaranteed return in every instructional segment for those recruitment features to be central.

citations.quote: We offer everybody a free lead capture page system that has certainly proven to work
you can capture the information and that way you'll be able to follow-up
you can also click right here on this blue button to sign up a new member

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The alleged ordinary-service framing overlooks the network structure. The dashboard visibly includes directly sponsored members and bonus-earned figures, while the narration connects the invite link to signing people up and arranging their placement. The video need not display a credential request or repeat a guarantee when it actively operationalizes sponsor-based recruitment tied to account metrics.
